conditions.text: Verified correct with a negative reference from the incoming call of ${Name} using the phone number ${phone_input} because the applicant is on the lease until ${Lease_End_Date} exceeding the 60-day lease overlap. To update, the applicant needs to provide a letter from the current housing provider (dated and signed on company letterhead) stating that they have made arrangements to break the lease early, the balance on the ledger/account is current, and the new move-out date or other details. If the reference has an email address with a business domain, an email to OSM_Verifications@realpage.com with the sender's complete name, title/position, contact information, the new move-out date, and other details is also acceptable.
